sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm outside the station, ready to go to my hotel.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've got a suitcase, and I ask a driver.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, can you take me to the Park Hotel?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, I'll start the meter when we leave.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: About how much will the trip cost?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: About twenty dollars, but it depends on the traffic.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: So that's not a set price for the whole trip?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Right, we use the meter to work out the price.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Does this taxi use the meter even when traffic's slow?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, the price can go up in slow traffic.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before getting in, I notice a card sign.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I pay by card when we get there?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, you can pay by card here.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I don't have much cash today.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No problem, just keep your card handy for the end.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can you put my suitcase in the trunk, please?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, I'll put it in the trunk.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, and can you drop me off at the main entrance?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Actually, there's a change at your hotel this morning.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Oh, is there somewhere else you can drop me off?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: We can drop you by the side door, since the front's closed till noon.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, which hotel entrance can you use today?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The side entrance, not the front.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I check the new location before we leave.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Is the side entrance far from the main one?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No, it's just around the corner, next to a bench.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, please drop me off there, near the bench.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, I'll help you get your suitcase out there too.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, can I have a receipt after I pay by card?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, I'll give you one when we get there.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I've got my card ready.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've checked the fare, payment, and where I'll get out.
